items.headline: Kava Lend Hacked for $3.8M, $KAVA Craters 40%
items.summary: Attackers bridged ~49.2M $KAVA to BNB Chain via LayerZero and dumped it for roughly $2.1M in $BNB and stablecoins, sending $KAVA down nearly 40%.

items.headline: $AERO Slides 27% in a Week as Merger Rally Unwinds
items.summary: $AERO's post-merger retreat erased October's rally, though its Base pools still hold ~$250M and handled $5.09B in weekly swaps.

items.headline: $LDO: Lido Lend Plan Would Freeze Repayments
items.summary: A proposed emergency pause on Lido Lend would block repayments, lender exits and liquidations, with a governance path to remove its auto-expiry. $LDO holders on alert.

items.headline: $SPK: Spark TVL Drops 15.3% to a 30-Day Low
items.summary: Spark's tracked TVL fell to $5.70B, a 30-day low, though the decline reflects asset prices rather than withdrawals or lost lending capacity. $SPK ecosystem cools.

items.headline: $ATOM: Cosmos Hub Votes on Governance Query Fix
items.summary: Proposal 1061 is above quorum with near-unanimous backing; validators would upgrade to Gaia v29.1.0 at block 33,935,300 if it passes. $ATOM governance in focus.
